verdicts.reason: Both are the same crop: the product flat-lay that makes up the original's imagery is cropped down to fragments (a cut-off jar rim, a blurry glass, leaf tips), and the bottom third is empty pink. In both, the beige brush-stroke backing has come loose from the 'Spa Utopia' headline and floats above it as an odd blank shape, where in the original it sat behind the text. In A the stroke floats higher (it ends about 80px above the headline), so it reads as even more of an orphaned blob. B's stroke runs down almost to the headline, which keeps a little more of the original's text-on-stroke grouping.
